description:
Welcome to True Preparedness — where Andrew and Jerome bring you a weekly deep-dive into real-world readiness, self-reliance, and off-grid living.
Here, we believe preparedness isn’t about fear — it’s about freedom, confidence, and peace of mind.

Each week, we share simple, proven tips on emergency planning, home defense, water storage, gardening, and the tools that make it all possible. You’ll also find real stories, gear reviews, and hands-on projects designed to help you live more independently and stay ready for anything.

Join a growing community of people who don’t just prepare — they live prepared.
Because when you’re truly ready, every day feels a little more secure, capable, and free.
